text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common mild side effects as well as rare, serious complications.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include burning, urgency, or frequent urination.
Genital yeast infections: Vaginal yeast infections in women (itching, burning, thick white discharge) and fungal infections around the penis in men.
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more frequently because the medication flushes out extra sugar through your urine.
Other mild effects: Upper respiratory infections, mild joint pain, nausea, increased thirst, or minor weight loss.

text_blocks.snippet: Seek emergency medical attention or contact your healthcare provider right away if you experience:

list.snippet: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, which can happen even if your blood sugar is not very high. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual fatigue, fruity-smelling breath, and trouble breathing.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Excessive loss of water and salt, causing dizziness, lightheadedness, or feeling faint—especially when standing up.

Severe genital or perineal infections (Necrotizing fasciitis / Fournier’s gangrene): A rare, life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin between the anus and genitals, causing fever, severe pain, swelling, or redness.
Low blood sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Kidney problems: Sudden worsening of kidney function or severe kidney infections (pyelonephritis).
Lower limb amputations: Increased risk reported in people with peripheral vascular disease or previous foot ulcers.
Serious allergic reactions: Hives, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and throat.

text_blocks.snippet: You can review full safety guidelines on the Jardiance Official Site or read the detailed overview on the Mayo Clinic Empagliflozin Guide.
